description: A substitute takes over a player's spot. During play: slot takeover — completed results stay, the change is shown ("Anna, for Kristjan from R3"). Before the first result: choose mode slot_swap (default) or regenerate (re-pair and redraw using levels). Unknown substitute names are added to the roster automatically.

level.description: Any consistent numeric level/rating — used only for seeding and balancing

request_id.description: Optional idempotency id — retrying a call with the same id never applies it twice

tournament_key.description: The tournament's organiser key (starts with tk_)

name: replace_player

preview.description: True when this is a preview — nothing was changed

title: Replace player (substitution)
